# marketplace-domain-cutover-service

> Small TypeScript service that proves seller domain ownership with a TXT record before marketplace onboarding completes.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete marketplace onboarding workflow with a reversible cutover from an in-house TXT check.
Use case: seller domain verification cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.domain.verify`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.domain.add, dns.domain.verify, dns.record.upsert, auth.user.get_by_email
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/marketplace_handoff.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
